ranking.reason: Family photos carry strong emotional stakes, and a visible before-and-after showing faces kept intact is an easy promise to understand and tap on, though the established restoration apps make it a crowded market.

The no-forced-cloud, no-subscription hook is concrete and appeals to privacy-minded buyers, but document scanning is a utilitarian need with less urgency and the category has many established players.
Caption timing drift is a narrow workflow frustration for a smaller group of creators, with fewer complaints (8) and a benefit that is hard to show in a single ad.
